target.role: fresh whole-journey belonging and placement discovery for STRANGE GAIT
target.position: Whole journey: before the opener, between every non-protected pair, or after the tail. Preserve only Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer; Truth in Noise → Transparency remains available.
target.purpose: Test one current syncopated structural arc, one emerging dub/IDM-adjacent cut, one adjacent high-speed broken construction, and two overlooked catalogue tracks across their strongest lawful placements. Character change is allowed; admission still requires purposeful transition, local-run and long-form effect.

sourceWindows: CURRENT 2026 / BENT RHYTHM: https://bentrhythm.bandcamp.com/album/say-no-to-the-status-quo — all four Liz Somes tracks were screened. The exact title track was retained from the label's syncopated-rhythm, detailed-percussion, methodical-build and collapse description; Beatport reports 142 BPM.

CURRENT / EMERGING DUB TECHNO FOR LIFE: https://sa-pa.bandcamp.com/album/girls-on-tour-ep — all four Sa Pa tracks were screened. World Saving Banger was retained from the label's exact broken, raw and IDM-leaning description; the August 2026 repress window was also checked through current Juno listings.

ADJACENT / BLOOD TRUST: https://bloodtrustmusic.bandcamp.com/album/digital-red-label-005 — both tracks were screened. Sanctuary was retained from the exact tech-step-snare, industrial-grind and syncopated-break description; the release-level 170 framing is not treated as exact-track BPM.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / MONDAY OFF: https://mondayoff.bandcamp.com/album/various-artists-vol-3 — all four 2019 tracks were screened. Michal Wolski — Morph was retained from the label's exact syncopated-rhythm, metallic-feature and wonky-business description.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / EVOD MUSIC: https://evodmusic.bandcamp.com/album/acromo — all six 2018 tracks were screened. Acromo 3 was retained from the label's exact five-step rising sequence and syncopated drum-loop description.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: Planet Rhythm's August/September 2026 Black Series releases, Black Magic Recordings' 2026 catalogue, current Juno techno listings, Systolic VA07, Sa Pa's September Rhythm From Ambient listing, Lab Personnel, and adjacent Bent Rhythm/Evod catalogue pages were screened. Planet Rhythm exclusives were kept as a release watch because the label states they are unavailable on streaming during the initial window; the other material did not outrank the five exact-track leads.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 52 named tracks across current releases, adjacent/emerging artists and labels, and overlooked catalogue windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Exact identities and primary discovery lanes retained in Runs 53–66 were not recycled.
The protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.
Remixes and alternate versions were excluded from the exact leads. No lead was promoted for recency, artist or label reputation, genre, novelty, title, BPM or technical cleverness.

Energy, density, space, hypnosis, perceived pulse, phrase structure, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown. Release-level tempo framing for Blood Trust is explicitly not converted into exact-track BPM.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Liz Somes — Say No To The Status Quo: strongest current exact structural arc, with syncopated percussion building methodically before collapse into darker space.
2. Evod — Acromo 3: strongest overlooked exact rhythmic-system case, with a five-step rising sequence against a syncopated drum loop.
3. Michal Wolski — Morph: strong overlooked wonky-syncopation case with exact-track label evidence.
4. Sa Pa — World Saving Banger: strongest emerging adjacent-world case, explicitly broken, raw and IDM-leaning.
5. Blood Trust — Sanctuary: strongest high-speed adjacent construction, with tech-step snares, industrial grind and syncopated breaks.
